<observations>
Date: Jul 15, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User stated they prefer running outdoors over treadmills and sleep exactly seven hours nightly.
* 🔴 (08:15) User stated they have a torn meniscus in the left knee.
* 🔴 (12:45) User stated they work as a graphic designer at a downtown agency, own a Garmin Forerunner 265 (resting HR 52 bpm), and train in Nike Pegasus shoes while disliking heavy pre-workout meals.
* ✅ (20:05) Provided nutritional insights on beetroot juice, generated eccentric calf raise routine, and scheduled morning training check-in.

Date: Jul 18, 2026
* 🔴 (09:00) User stated they prefer coconut water over sports drinks, listen to indie rock while running, take evening magnesium, and walk with their pet golden retriever.
* 🔴 (15:15) User stated they work from home on Thursdays and Fridays.
* ✅ (20:30) Retrieved anti-chafing balm recommendations, summarized dynamic warm-up benefits, and updated weekly training log (28-mile goal).

Date: Jul 21, 2026
* 🔴 (09:30) User stated their favorite running socks are Merino wool and that they have been a vegetarian for over four years.
* ✅ (17:00) Provided trail shoe cleaning tips, logged planned foam roller purchase, and updated daily recovery log.

Date: Jul 24, 2026
* 🔴 (08:45) User stated they prefer black coffee before long runs and only eat whole-wheat pasta the night before hard workouts.
* 🔴 (11:00) User stated they refuse to run with headphones on busy streets.
* 🔴 (12:10) User stated their half marathon is on September 4, 2026.
* ✅ (17:00) Evaluated hot-weather electrolyte needs and swimming cross-training, adding insulated water bottles to the shopping list.

Date: Jul 28, 2026
* 🔴 (08:45) User stated they prefer stretching on high-density foam rollers.
* 🔴 (11:00) User stated they refuse to carry a bouncing waist pack during tempo runs.
* 🔴 (13:15) User stated they only eat steel-cut oats with blueberries on high-mileage mornings.
* ✅ (17:00) Evaluated stationary cycling recovery, retrieved compression sock pressure ratings, and updated recovery schedule.

Date: Aug 1, 2026
* 🔴 (08:45) User stated they strongly dislike static stretching before morning track sessions.
* 🔴 (11:00) User stated they refuse to wear neon-colored apparel during early morning road runs.
* 🔴 (13:15) User stated they only drink lemon-infused coconut water immediately following long runs.
* 🔴 (18:20) User stated they have never had a cardiac stress test.
* ✅ (17:00) Analyzed hamstring flexibility, provided hot-weather hydration temperature guidance, and updated monthly training log.
</observations>
